23 independent Codex skills with a selective installer.

- Updated the README with installation, skill selection, and usage instructions.
- Available on [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/task-solver-suite/v/3.0.1) and [GitHub Packages](https://github.com/Abenteur3r/task-solver-suite/pkgs/npm/task-solver-suite).

Requires Node.js 22+.

```bash
npx task-solver-suite@3.0.1 install --skill ml --skill research
```

The installer and skill workflows remain untested; see [validation status](https://github.com/Abenteur3r/task-solver-suite/blob/v3.0.1/VALIDATION.md).
